stories.title: Trump promises 'economic D-Day' as new Iran sanctions loom
stories.reason: The administration is shifting to Treasury-led economic pressure on Iran, signaling a new phase of the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: US-Canada trade war escalates as 50% tariffs take effect
stories.reason: Talks collapsed and Canada plans dollar-for-dollar retaliation starting September 8, a major escalation between two of the world's largest trading partners.

stories.title: OpenAI says its products have surpassed 1 billion active users
stories.reason: A milestone reached faster than any consumer software platform in history, underscoring how quickly generative AI has gone mainstream.

stories.title: DARPA and US Air Force fly an F-16 fully under AI control
stories.reason: A major milestone for autonomous combat aviation, with the onboard pilot only monitoring rather than flying the jet.

stories.title: Traders see a September ECB rate hike as the Iran war fuels energy-driven inflation
stories.reason: The ECB's first rate-hike cycle in three years is being driven by war-linked energy costs, with inflation projected to stay above target into 2027.

stories.title: Meta launches Muse Code, its first AI coding agent, to challenge OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.reason: Meta is entering the increasingly crowded AI coding-agent market, intensifying competition among the biggest AI labs.

stories.title: Nvidia to build the Starmind AI1 satellite compute payload for SpaceX
stories.reason: SpaceX is moving AI data centers into orbit exclusively on Nvidia hardware, a striking bet on space-based computing.

stories.title: Global Economy Briefing: Fed minutes show growing split over an immediate rate hike
stories.reason: A 9-3 vote split among Fed officials suggests the central bank is closer to raising rates than recent market calm would suggest.
